persons.name: Vekhānandana
persons.evidence: The scribe appears to be one Vekhānandana.

notes: Bendall dates the manuscript in the header to N.S. 986 (1866 CE), but prints 'संवत् ७८३ (see above)' in the extract, likely reflecting the visual similarity between Newari numerals 986 and Devanāgarī 783. Pārāvata-mahāvihāra is Itum Bāhā in Kathmandu; Bhāskaradeva and Keśavacandra are part of the traditional name of the vihāra. 'मालिचि' refers to the goddess Mārīcī, illustrated on folio 258b.
